official_sources.title: PDAL LAS Reader — coordinate scaling and SRS
official_sources.finding: LAS stores X/Y/Z as scaled integers; source scale/offset and SRS must be preserved or explicitly controlled when reading/writing.
official_sources.limitation: Generic processing guard; it does not prove Environment Agency target asset identity or parcel elevation accuracy.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: PDAL LAS Reading and Writing Tutorial
official_sources.finding: LAS coordinate scaling uses 32-bit integer storage and header forwarding across multiple inputs can fall back to defaults when values differ.
official_sources.limitation: Generic processing guidance; target survey headers and exact source files still need runtime verification.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: PDAL SMRF Ground Classification
official_sources.finding: SMRF classifies ground/non-ground and exposes slope, threshold, window, return-type and class-bit choices that materially affect ground support.
official_sources.limitation: Algorithmic classification is not a substitute for the official provider's reviewed DTM or survey-specific ground truth.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: PDAL Cloth Simulation Filter
official_sources.finding: CSF ground classification depends on cloth resolution, threshold, height-difference, rigidness, returns and iteration settings.
official_sources.limitation: Alternative ground classifier; disagreement with official classifications must be treated as QA evidence, not silent replacement.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: PDAL Outlier Filter
official_sources.finding: Statistical and radius outlier filters mark noise points rather than deleting them; downstream exclusion must be explicit.
official_sources.limitation: Outlier thresholds can remove legitimate local extrema if misapplied; terminal parcel extrema must retain provenance of every exclusion.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: PDAL Sparse Surface Filter
official_sources.finding: Sparse-surface processing assumes ground-labelled input and can reclassify nearby low points based on a radius.
official_sources.limitation: Useful for QA only; sparse subsampling must never replace full official ground support for terminal extrema.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: PDAL GDAL Raster Writer
official_sources.finding: Point-to-raster conversion is interpolated around cell centers; radius, resolution, output statistic, window fallback and NoData choices alter raster values.
official_sources.limitation: A raster generated this way is derived; native official DTM pixels are preferred for terminal parcel elevation where available.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: PDAL Height Above Ground — nearest neighbors
official_sources.finding: HAG nearest-neighbor values depend on ground classification, neighbor count, distance limit and extrapolation policy.
official_sources.limitation: Relative HAG is not absolute elevation and must not be confused with ODN-referenced terrain height.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: PDAL Height Above Ground — DEM
official_sources.finding: HAG DEM compares point Z with a GDAL-readable terrain raster at the corresponding XY location.
official_sources.limitation: HAG is a derived relative height check; it is not itself the parcel min/max terrain elevation result.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: USGS Lidar Base Specification — processing and handling
official_sources.finding: The current USGS LBS requires LAS 1.4-R15, consistent classification, seamless tile edge matching and rejection of duplicated points; these are strong generic LiDAR QA controls.
official_sources.limitation: USGS requirements are used as independent QA methodology only, not as the governing specification for Environment Agency data.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: USGS Lidar Base Specification — tables
official_sources.finding: The LBS publishes quality-level pulse density, relative vertical accuracy, classification and DEM cell-size tables.
official_sources.limitation: Thresholds are USGS program requirements, not England target-survey acceptance limits; they serve only as comparative QA context.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: USGS Lidar Base Specification — collection requirements
official_sources.finding: Collection requirements explicitly address nominal pulse spacing, data voids, spatial distribution, collection conditions and overlap.
official_sources.limitation: Independent collection-QA reference only; target survey acquisition metadata must come from the official England source.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: USGS Lidar Base Specification — deliverables
official_sources.finding: Bare-earth DEM generation uses ground-classified, non-withheld points and requires supporting metadata; ignored-ground treatment is explicitly separated to avoid interpolation artifacts.
official_sources.limitation: Methodology reference only; Environment Agency DTM production/editing rules remain authoritative for target data.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: USGS revision — updated vertical accuracy standards
official_sources.finding: Updated LBS accuracy language distinguishes current RMSE_V reporting and requires survey error to be included in nonvegetated vertical-accuracy calculation.
official_sources.limitation: This is a USGS/ASPRS methodology reference; it does not override the Environment Agency survey-specific Ground Truth report.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: USGS revision — vertical accuracy assessment using ground points
official_sources.finding: Vertical-accuracy assessment is based on ground-classified points for both nonvegetated and vegetated assessment paths.
official_sources.limitation: Independent QA methodology; the target parcel still requires official survey/tile lineage and provider QA evidence.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: USGS revision — LAS Withheld flag
official_sources.finding: The Withheld flag identifies returns that cannot reasonably be interpreted as valid surface returns, including outliers, blunders and sensor anomalies.
official_sources.limitation: Withheld treatment is a generic LAS-quality guard; exact target filtering must follow the source dataset's documented semantics.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification, government standard, or project documentation; publisher terms apply
